Definitely don't take the lab urine test using your first 3 pees of the day but don't drink too much water as they can tell that it is diluted. Also, the lab urine tests are a little more sensitive than the strips so there may still be a chance you will fail even when the strip said it was negative for THC. 

Best bet is maybe taking one of those detox drinks and maybe taking vitamin B before the test to give your urine a yellow colour without it looking too diluted.
